term: what this drawing does not know
definition: The corpus records where a style arose in words and holds no coordinates, so each point on the map comes from a gazetteer in the interface.
more: The gazetteer is keyed on the region and hearth names the records use: a point is accurate to the size of the thing named and no better, and none of the points is a source.
basis: The limit of the map reading, as the workbench's own documentation states it. docs/workbench.md, on where the points come from: the gazetteer is "interface furniture, not corpus data", and the corpus "holds no coordinates, and per the sourcing rules none of these numbers may migrate into" the style records; a style is placed "taking the finest thing either names" of its regions and its hearth.
